sn35.133:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā udāyi kāmaṇḍāyaṃ viharati todeyyassa brāhmaṇassa ambavane.
sn35.133:1.2: atha kho verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā antevāsī māṇavako yenāyasmā udāyi tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā udāyinā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn35.133:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn35.133:1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ māṇavakaṃ āyasmā udāyi dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
sn35.133:1.5: atha kho māṇavako āyasmatā udāyinā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā yena verahañcānigottā brāhmaṇī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā verahañcānigottaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ etadavoca
sn35.133:1.7: samaṇo udāyi dhammaṃ deseti ādikallāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetīti.
sn35.133:2.1: tenahi tvaṃ māṇavaka mama vacanena samaṇaṃ udāyiṃ nimantehi svātanāya bhattenāti
sn35.133:2.2: evaṃ bhotīti kho so māṇavako verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā paṭissutvā yenāyasmā udāyi tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca
sn35.133:2.3: adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ udāyi amhākaṃ ācariyāya verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā svātanāya bhattanti.
sn35.133:2.5: atha kho āyasmā udāyi tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn35.133:2.6: atha kho verahañcānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ paṇītena khādaniṃyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
sn35.133:2.7: atha kho verahañcānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ pādukā ārohitvā ucce āsane nisīditvā sīsaṃ oguṇṭhitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca
sn35.133:2.9: bhavissati bhagini samayoti vatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
sn35.133:3.1: dutiyampi kho so māṇavako yenāyasmā udāyi tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā udāyinā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn35.133:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn35.133:3.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ māṇavakaṃ āyasmā udāyi dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
sn35.133:3.4: dutiyampi kho so māṇavako āyasmatā udāyinā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā yena verahañcānigottā brāhmaṇī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā verahañcānigottaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ etadavoca
sn35.133:3.6: samaṇo udāyi dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetīti.
sn35.133:4.1: evamevaṃ pana tvaṃ māṇavaka samaṇassa udāyissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsasi
sn35.133:4.2: samaṇo udāyi bhaṇa samaṇa dhammanti vutto samāno bhavissati bhagini samayoti vatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkantoti
sn35.133:4.3: tathā hi pana tvaṃ bhoti pādukā ārohitvā ucce āsane nisīditvā sīsaṃ oguṇṭhitvā etadavoca
sn35.133:4.6: tenahi tvaṃ māṇavaka mama vacanena samaṇaṃ udāyiṃ nimantehi svātanāya bhattenāti.
sn35.133:4.7: evaṃ bhotīti kho so māṇavako verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā paṭissutvā yenāyasmā udāyi tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca
sn35.133:4.8: adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ udāyi amhākaṃ ācariyabhariyāya verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā svātanāya bhattanti.
sn35.133:5.1: atha kho āyasmā udāyi tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena verahañcānigottāya brāhmaṇiyā nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn35.133:5.2: atha kho verahañcānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
sn35.133:5.3: atha kho verahañcānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ pādukā orohitvā nīce āsane nisīditvā sīsaṃ vivaritvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca
sn35.133:5.4: kismiṃ nu kho bhante sati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti kismiṃ asati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ na paññapentīti.
sn35.133:6.1: cakkhusmiṃ kho bhagini sati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti cakkhusmiṃ asati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ na paññapenti …pe…
sn35.133:6.2: jivhāya sati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti jivhāya asati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ na paññapenti …pe…
sn35.133:6.3: manasmiṃ sati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti manasmiṃ asati arahanto sukhadukkhaṃ na paññapentīti.
sn35.133:7.1: evaṃ vutte verahañcānigottā brāhmaṇī āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca
sn35.133:7.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evamevaṃ ayyena udāyinā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn35.133:7.4: esāhaṃ bhante udāyi taṃ bhavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn35.133:7.5: upāsikaṃ maṃ ayyo udāyi dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
